title: The Harbor Ledger (E2E)
story_prompt: A fog-bound harbor city detective story: Marta Voss hunts the smuggler Ivo Krane, whose ledger implicates her father. Edda Grimm runs the rope street dock office.

characters.name: Marta Voss
characters.description: Inspector, dry humor, hunting the ledger.

characters.name: Ivo Krane
characters.description: Smuggler with a book of debts.

characters.name: Edda Grimm
characters.description: Runs the dock office; knows everyone.

settings.name: Rope Street
settings.description: Narrow lane of chandlers above the wharf.

lore.name: The Ledger
lore.description: A sealed book of harbor debts; opening it is a crime.

outline.premise: Marta Voss (aliases, Ivo Krane (aliases, Edda Grimm (aliases converge in a fog-bound harbor city, and a ledger of old debts decides who survives the coming storm.

chapters.name: Chapter 1: Ledger Debts
chapters.description: Marta and Ivo meet at the harbor; Edda warns them; the ledger appears.

chapters.name: Chapter 2: The Storm
